design.purpose: Explain original-score operating results without repeating completed specifications; start determinants using existing classifications. No paid API.
design.original_score: Reuse all saved full-period estimates. Only add original saved score and original raw share excluding predictor years 2020/2021, full and core controls, four outcomes; paired baselines. No new winsorization search or label changes.
design.determinants_population: Complete classified fiscal cohorts in existing linked review panel, without requiring future outcomes or R&D/advertising disclosure. At least five current reviews primary; all and ten-review sensitivities.
design.past_normal: Current share minus review-weighted share in preceding three fiscal years, requiring >=10 prior reviews and >=2 distinct prior years. No future information.
design.determinants: Previous-fiscal-year operating ROA deterioration, sales decline, firm operating uncertainty (3 annual ROAs), public-US-firm SIC2 sales competition (1-HHI), industry sales decline; previous-fiscal-year stock return and monthly volatility from dated CCM/CRSP links. Predictors lagged; no causal intent claim.
design.financial_universe: USD INDL STD C annual statements, one unique issuer/fiscal year. Exclude ambiguous duplicates. HHI uses full US-incorporated positive-sales public-firm universe, minimum five firms; not only review companies.
design.main_estimation: Unweighted company-year OLS, company and year effects, company-clustered finite-sample SE and t(G-1). Controls lag log assets, leverage, ROA, CAPX/assets and log(1+current reviews). Continuous financial predictors capped at 1/99 in review-linked determinant population before any estimation. Predictors standardized using that fixed population.
design.specifications: Each determinant separately with common controls; joint financial model; joint financial+market model. Three outcomes; all/min5/min10; level and deviation for main joint model. All estimates retained and Holm p-values reported by outcome across main determinant tests.
design.roles: Fixed transparent title groups: management, professional/technical, sales/customer, operations/service, other. Review-level comparisons descriptive, not evidence of employer intent. Future-role flag describes pipeline language, not proven recurring hires.

stock_link_coverage.history: Dated LC/LU P/C CCM links; P first then largest observed class; 10/11 share codes; no future months; returns compound; volatility annualized monthly standard deviation. Delisting returns not separately added; source monthly RET.

inherited_universe: Existing reviewed financial/posting-linked cohorts, 2016–2024; determinant comparisons do not represent all 6.3 million supplied reviews. No future-outcome complete-case screen is additionally imposed in these determinant fits.
paper_tables: Original five main tables and four appendix tables preserved; added main role table and two appendix tables; revised Figure 1.
